whatItFakes: Counted people serving a jail, prison or juvenile term keep their pay: a counted case's custody is a head count by counted group (CountedCustodyRow), with no record of which member serves, so no counted member's job ends and no counted household loses an earner, as a named prisoner's household does (endCustodyJobs, parent-incarceration-to-household-income).
why: The justice engine files counted defendants as fractional cases by group and age band (arrest and resolveDue in src/core2/public-safety.ts); the counts carry no member, and choosing one without a record would be a roll.
replacement: A record of which counted members a counted term holds, decided from their own records (the age band, the group's members and their jobs), so the jobs engine ends their jobs for the term as it does a named prisoner's, and the counted household's income loses that pay.
